<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import re
def dotpos(fr):
    b=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(b) for j,c in enumerate(row) if c=='r' and i<50 and not (29<=i<=33 and 50<=j<=54)]
    return pts
def box(fr,ch):
    b=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(b) for j,c in enumerate(row) if c==ch and i<50]
    if not pts:return None
    return (min(i for i,_ in pts),max(i for i,_ in pts),min(j for _,j in pts),max(j for _,j in pts),len(pts))
for idx in range(24,40):
    t=transitions[idx]
    m=re.search(r'row=(\d+), col=(\d+)',t.action)
    rc=(int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2)))
    dp_b=dotpos(t.before_frame); dp_a=dotpos(t.after_frame)
    gb=box(t.before_frame,'N'); ga=box(t.after_frame,'N')
    yb=box(t.before_frame,'Y'); ya=box(t.after_frame,'Y')
    sb=box(t.before_frame,'S'); sa=box(t.after_frame,'S')
    ob=box(t.before_frame,'O'); oa=box(t.after_frame,'O')
    print(f"[{idx}] btn{rc} dot {dp_b}->{dp_a}")
    if gb!=ga:print("   grn",gb,ga)
    if yb!=ya:print("   yel",yb,ya)
    if sb!=sa:print("   sky",sb,sa)
    if ob!=oa:print("   org",ob,oa)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
